property_summary: For any user who locks in a guess and then calls settle in a later block, the reference C computes the answer from the exact block hash of the block recorded at lock time, so an attacker cannot force a win by choosing a guess after seeing that block hash; the mutant computes the answer from blockhash(block.number), which is always zero for the current block, making the answer a fixed constant that an attacker can precompute and lock as their guess to always win 2 ether.
change_summary: Change the unused-answer hash source from blockhash(guesses[msg.sender].block) to blockhash(block.number), so the answer depends on the current block instead of the locked block.
